summary: Missoula County, MT lookout site: D-6 cupola cabin in the 1920s, 50-foot pole L-4 tower in 1933, destroyed 1963; a 2019 summit report describes a concrete base, ground wire, glass and rotting wood as all that is visibly left.

notes_for_editor: Identity needs a check before publishing. The 2019 report is titled Petty Mountain and tags Petty Ridge Lookout as a keyword; the Montana county list also has a separate Petty Mountain entry (Lolo NF, 13N-22W-5), and the merge report places a Petty Mountain record about 32 m from this record. The report gives no coordinates, so the same-site link rests on the keyword and the matching 1933/1963 dates. The 1920s establishment is given only as a decade, so it is not an events row. The 2019 remains are one visitor's observation, not a survey. The 50-foot height is converted from feet. No photos were added.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 2019 report is titled Petty Mountain and tags the site Petty Ridge Lookout; the FFLA list and firelookout.com use Petty Ridge, so the record keeps that name. A separate Petty Mountain entry on the county list is not confirmed as the same site.
